type_invalid.cause: Invalid commit type (not in allowed enum)
type_invalid.fix: Use valid type: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert

header_too_long.pattern: header must not be longer than
header_too_long.cause: Commit header exceeds maximum length (100 chars)
header_too_long.fix: Shorten commit message, move details to body

compilation_error.fix: Check error details, fix syntax/import errors, rebuild

dependency_not_found.fix: Check dependency coordinates, update repositories, clear cache

test_failure.fix: Review test failure details, fix code or update test expectations

coverage_threshold.pattern: coverage is below|Code coverage .* is below
coverage_threshold.fix: Add more tests to increase coverage or adjust threshold

formatting_error.pattern: Execution failed for task.*spotlessCheck|The following files had format violations
formatting_error.cause: Code formatting doesn't match spotless rules
formatting_error.fix: Run './gradlew spotlessApply' locally and commit changes
